name: carry-paper
summary: Pablo recycles a newspaper made a metre in front of him (PaperPlaceProbe): the game's CarrySystem.PickUp turns the paper's floor shadow off (Objects.EnableDropShadow, CarrySystem.cs:287), an Ob line the client replays on its copy (seam-gaps row 6); the watch covers the pick-up and the walk to the trash can (14 s), then 25 s for both games to finish the walk back before the compare (the walk back is FastWalk through a door, where pace flags are an older walk defect: sleep-bed 27 of 373 runs). prop:FoodProp is --known: the food fridge-snack leaves on the counter differs (fridge-snack's known failure)
